title: Compliance reports are listed under the NCM tab

steps.action: Login as admin (admin/admin); navigate Reports
steps.expected: Reports section loads

steps.action: Open the NCM tab
steps.expected: Compliance reports are listed there

title: A new "Compliance" category lists all compliance reports

steps.action: Login as admin (admin/admin); navigate Reports > NCM
steps.expected: Categories are listed

steps.action: Click the "Compliance" category
steps.expected: All compliance reports are shown under it

title: Executive Summary report renders as designed

steps.action: Login as admin (admin/admin); navigate Reports > NCM > Compliance and run the Executive Summary report
steps.expected: Report generates

steps.action: Compare against Figma node-id 4685-48025 in the Reports file and the attached sample PDF
steps.expected: Sections, tables and figures match the design

title: Audit Policy report renders as designed

steps.action: Login as admin (admin/admin); navigate Reports > NCM > Compliance and run the Audit Policy report
steps.expected: Report generates

steps.action: Compare against Figma node-id 4685-48025 and the attached sample
steps.expected: Layout and content match. QA recorded that only the Executive Summary existed at one point — confirm this report is now actually present

title: GAP All three designed reports exist

steps.action: Login as admin (admin/admin); navigate Reports > NCM > Compliance and list the available reports
steps.expected: List loads

steps.action: Compare against the wireframe
steps.expected: The wireframe calls for three reports — Executive Summary, Audit Policy (CIS Cisco) and a per-device CIS report. QA logged that only Executive Summary was available. This case fails until all three ship

title: Per-device compliance summary downloads from the PDF icon on the per-device screen

steps.action: Open NCM compliance and drill into a single device's compliance screen
steps.expected: Per-device compliance screen loads

steps.action: Click the PDF icon
steps.expected: The per-device compliance summary PDF downloads. This is the only entry point specified for it

title: The same per-device report downloads from Export PDF on the NCM compliance tab

steps.action: Open the NCM compliance tab
steps.expected: Tab loads with an Export PDF button

steps.action: Click Export PDF
steps.expected: The same report content downloads as from the per-device PDF icon — identical data, not a different report

title: GAP Device rule-level report exists

steps.action: Look for a device rule-level compliance report
steps.expected: Report list is inspected

steps.action: Confirm availability
steps.expected: PMG reopened this ticket specifically because the device rule-level report is missing; the developer states it was agreed for a future sprint. This case fails until the scope disagreement is settled by the team

title: REOPENED Exported PDF matches the expected PDF format

steps.action: Export the Executive Summary PDF
steps.expected: PDF downloads

steps.action: Compare page by page against the attached expected PDF
steps.expected: Layout, sections and tables match. PMG reopened the ticket stating the report PDF does not match the expected PDF. Expect a fail until fixed

title: REOPENED Large numbers render readably in the compliance UI

steps.action: Open the NCM compliance screens on a dataset producing large counts
steps.expected: Screens load

steps.action: Inspect the numeric fields and tiles
steps.expected: Values are formatted/abbreviated and fit their containers. PMG reopened the ticket stating some numbers are very huge in the UI. Expect a fail until fixed

title: Long reports paginate rather than overflowing

steps.action: Run a compliance report over enough devices and policies to exceed one page
steps.expected: Report generates

steps.action: Inspect the PDF
steps.expected: Content paginates with repeated headers and no clipped rows — the ticket requires pagination when length exceeds the sample

title: Last scan time is present in each report

steps.action: Run each compliance report
steps.expected: Reports generate

steps.action: Look for the last scan time
steps.expected: Each report shows the last scan time for the data it presents, as requested in the ticket comments

title: Report data matches the compliance screen for the same policy

steps.action: Note pass/fail counts for a compliance policy on the NCM compliance screen
steps.expected: Counts recorded

steps.action: Run the report for the same policy and window
steps.expected: Report figures match the screen exactly — no double counting and no stale cached figures

title: Custom compliance category report can be built and run

steps.action: Create a custom report against a custom compliance category
steps.expected: Report is saved

steps.action: Run it
steps.expected: It generates with the expected compliance data, as QA verified for custom compliance category reports

title: Scheduled compliance report is delivered by email

steps.action: Schedule a compliance report to a reachable mailbox at the nearest run time
steps.expected: Schedule is created

steps.action: Wait for the run
steps.expected: The email arrives with the report attached and its content matches an on-demand run of the same report

title: GAP CSV and XLSX export support

steps.action: Attempt to export a compliance report as CSV and as XLSX
steps.expected: Export is attempted

steps.action: Inspect the result
steps.expected: QA logged that CSV and XLSX are not supported and raised MOTADATA-8430 separately. Confirm whether these formats are in scope here; if not, the option should not be offered

title: Compliance policy run completes without a hanging loader

steps.action: Run a compliance policy against a device set including one with no matching rule data
steps.expected: Policy run starts

steps.action: Watch the screen
steps.expected: The run completes or fails with a message. QA hit a permanent loader caused by an ArrayIndexOutOfBounds in the compliance rule engine, tracked as MOTADATA-8440 — verify it does not reproduce through the report path

title: Report generation works in an HA deployment

steps.action: Run and schedule a compliance report on an HA deployment, then fail over
steps.expected: Failover completes

steps.action: Re-run and check the schedule
steps.expected: Reports generate on the surviving node and schedules still fire — the developer flagged HA as needing verification

title: Report reflects the necessary backend config data

steps.action: Run a compliance report after a fresh compliance scan
steps.expected: Report generates

steps.action: Compare its figures with the scan results
steps.expected: Values come from the populated compliance config data and are current — the backend was changed to write the data the report needs

title: Empty state: report over a policy with no scanned devices

steps.action: Run a compliance report for a policy that has never been scanned
steps.expected: Report generates

steps.action: Inspect the output
steps.expected: A clear empty/no-data state rather than a blank page, a zero-filled table implying compliance, or an error

title: RBAC: a user without compliance rights cannot run or download the reports

steps.action: Log in as a user whose role lacks NCM compliance access and open Reports
steps.expected: Reports section loads per role

steps.action: Attempt to run and to download a compliance report
steps.expected: The Compliance category and its exports are unavailable or rejected; no report data is disclosed

title: RBAC: scheduled report recipients cannot be used to leak restricted data

steps.action: As a restricted user, attempt to schedule a compliance report to an external address
steps.expected: Attempt is made

steps.action: Inspect the outcome
steps.expected: Either scheduling is blocked for that role or the report content is scoped to what the user may see — a schedule must not widen data access

title: CSV-injection safety in any tabular compliance export

steps.action: Create a compliance policy or device name beginning with =cmd|' /C calc'!A0 and include it in an export
steps.expected: Export is produced

steps.action: Open the export in Excel
steps.expected: The leading =/+/-/@ is neutralised and no formula executes

title: XSS payload in a policy or device name is escaped in the report

steps.action: Name a compliance policy <script>alert(1)</script> and run a report including it
steps.expected: Report generates

steps.action: Open the HTML report and the PDF
steps.expected: The name renders as literal escaped text in both; no script executes and the PDF is not corrupted

title: Report generation time is acceptable at scale

steps.action: Run the Executive Summary over the largest available device and policy set
steps.expected: Report generates

steps.action: Measure the duration
steps.expected: It completes within an acceptable window without timing out or blocking other report runs

title: Report template changes do not break other report categories

steps.action: Run reports from other categories (NCM non-compliance, availability, metric) after the compliance templates ship
steps.expected: Reports generate

steps.action: Inspect each
steps.expected: All unaffected. The team chose separate per-report HTML templates for compliance, so no shared generic template should have regressed
